title: Inter-VLAN route missing
symptom: PC in VLAN 30 gets IP but cannot reach server; gateway ping works
topology_note: Router-on-a-stick connects VLAN 30 to server VLAN
show_outputs: show ip route has no 10.10.40.0/24 route; show ip interface brief shows up/up

title: ACL blocks server
symptom: PC reaches gateway but server ping fails
topology_note: SVIs route traffic through an extended ACL
show_outputs: show access-lists 110 shows deny ip 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.10.40.10

title: Native VLAN mismatch
symptom: Trunk comes up but VLAN 30 hosts fail intermittently
topology_note: Two switches use a trunk between access closets
show_outputs: show interfaces trunk reports native vlan mismatch

title: Missing access VLAN
symptom: New PC has no connectivity
topology_note: Access port should be in VLAN 20
show_outputs: show vlan brief does not list VLAN 20; interface is inactive

title: Wrong subnet mask
symptom: PC can reach local host but not remote subnet
topology_note: Two /24 LANs connect through a router
show_outputs: show ip interface brief shows 192.168.10.1 255.255.255.0 but hosts expect /25

title: Wrong default gateway
symptom: Client receives address but cannot ping gateway
topology_note: DHCP serves the Sales VLAN
show_outputs: ipconfig shows default gateway 192.168.50.1; SVI is 192.168.50.254

title: Interface administratively down
symptom: Branch LAN is completely unreachable
topology_note: Router interface connects to branch switch
show_outputs: GigabitEthernet0/1 is administratively down; line protocol is down

title: Physical link down
symptom: Access switch loses all connected users
topology_note: Copper link connects switch to router
show_outputs: show interfaces Gi0/1 reports line protocol is down

title: DHCP pool exhausted
symptom: Some clients get APIPA addresses
topology_note: Scope supports 20 clients
show_outputs: show ip dhcp pool USERS shows 100 percent leased

title: DHCP excluded gateway missing
symptom: Clients receive router address conflict
topology_note: Gateway must be excluded from pool
show_outputs: show ip dhcp binding includes 10.0.10.1; show run lacks ip dhcp excluded-address

title: DHCP relay missing
symptom: Remote VLAN clients receive no IP
topology_note: Clients are separated from central DHCP server
show_outputs: show run interface vlan 40 has no ip helper-address

title: DNS server typo
symptom: Users can ping IPs but not names
topology_note: Workstations receive DNS via DHCP
show_outputs: ipconfig /all shows DNS 10.0.90.99; valid server is 10.0.90.10

title: DNS service unavailable
symptom: Web names fail while gateway works
topology_note: Internal DNS is hosted on server VLAN
show_outputs: nslookup returns server failed; ping 10.0.90.10 fails

title: Static route typo
symptom: Branch cannot reach headquarters
topology_note: Two routers use a static WAN route
show_outputs: show ip route 10.20.0.0 shows next hop 172.16.99.2 but WAN uses 172.16.9.2

title: OSPF network omitted
symptom: New subnet is not learned by peers
topology_note: OSPF runs between three routers
show_outputs: show ip ospf neighbor is up; show ip route ospf lacks 10.30.30.0/24

title: OSPF passive interface
symptom: Router has no neighbor on transit
topology_note: Transit interface was copied from LAN template
show_outputs: show ip protocols lists GigabitEthernet0/1 as passive

title: NAT inside missing
symptom: Users cannot browse internet
topology_note: Edge router translates inside private addresses
show_outputs: show ip nat translations is empty; interface Gi0/0 lacks ip nat inside

title: NAT overload missing
symptom: Only first user reaches internet
topology_note: Many clients share one public address
show_outputs: show run has ip nat inside source list 1 pool PUBLIC but no overload

title: NAT ACL wrong
symptom: Internet access fails for one subnet
topology_note: ACL 1 should match 192.168.60.0/24
show_outputs: show access-lists 1 permits 192.168.16.0 0.0.0.255

title: Guest ACL absent
symptom: Guest Wi-Fi can reach internal server
topology_note: Guest VLAN should have internet-only access
show_outputs: show access-lists has no deny to 10.0.0.0/8; guest client pings 10.0.20.10

title: Wrong wireless VLAN
symptom: Wireless clients get staff addresses
topology_note: AP SSID Guest should tag VLAN 70
show_outputs: show vlan brief shows AP trunk allows 10,20 but not 70

title: AP authentication mismatch
symptom: Clients cannot join secure SSID
topology_note: AP and clients use WPA2-PSK
show_outputs: debug dot11 reports authentication failure; configured key differs from lab notes

title: DHCP duplicate IP
symptom: Two PCs intermittently lose connectivity
topology_note: Static printer address is reserved
show_outputs: show ip dhcp conflict shows 10.0.80.25 duplicate IP

title: Trunk VLAN not allowed
symptom: VLAN 40 works on switch A but not B
topology_note: Inter-switch trunk carries selected VLANs
show_outputs: show interfaces trunk allowed vlan is 10,20,30; VLAN 40 absent

title: Router subinterface down
symptom: One VLAN cannot reach gateway
topology_note: Router-on-a-stick uses dot1q subinterfaces
show_outputs: show ip interface brief shows Gi0/0.50 administratively down

title: HSRP wrong virtual gateway
symptom: Hosts lose gateway after failover
topology_note: Two distribution switches provide redundant gateway
show_outputs: show standby vlan 60 shows virtual IP 10.60.0.254; clients use 10.60.0.1

title: ACL applied wrong direction
symptom: HTTP works but return traffic fails
topology_note: Server VLAN has an inbound filter
show_outputs: show run interface SVI shows ip access-group 120 out; ACL denies established return traffic

title: Port security violation
symptom: One access port is disabled
topology_note: Port allows one known endpoint
show_outputs: show port-security interface Gi0/12 shows secure-shutdown and violation count 1

title: STP blocked path
symptom: Redundant switch path is unavailable
topology_note: Two switches have redundant links
show_outputs: show spanning-tree shows Gi0/24 in blocking state for required VLAN

title: MTU mismatch
symptom: Large pings fail but small pings work
topology_note: Two routed links use different MTUs
show_outputs: show interfaces shows MTU 1500 on one side and 1400 on peer

title: Wireless DHCP scope wrong
symptom: Guest clients receive staff subnet
topology_note: Guest SSID uses dedicated DHCP scope
show_outputs: show ip dhcp binding gives 10.0.10.55 to Guest-AP
expected_fault: Guest DHCP scope or VLAN mismatch

title: Server default gateway wrong
symptom: Server can reach same subnet only
topology_note: Server is in VLAN 40 with SVI gateway
show_outputs: server ipconfig shows gateway 10.10.30.1; SVI is 10.10.40.1
